description: Replaces .github/dependabot.yml (workflow-2.0 Batch 8.5). Every ignore below is a transcribed dependabot.yml rule with its reason; keep both files in sync until dependabot.yml is deleted after the first green Renovate PR.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Backend: minor+patch grouped monthly (was dependabot group backend-minor-patch).
@types/node must describe the runtime: node:22-alpine in backend/Dockerfile, CI node-version 22, engines.node >=22. Bump base image + types in one commit, then drop this rule.
Nest family moves as ONE major and cannot yet: @nestjs/throttler peers ^11 only, Nest 12 breaks WsThrottlerGuard. Re-check when throttler peers ^12; then do the family in one PR and delete this rule.
TypeScript 7 strands type-aware lint: typescript-eslint 8.70 peers typescript <6.1.0 (Batch 8.9). Drop when typescript-eslint peers TS 7.

Frontend: NO groupName on purpose — dependabot's grouped pub PRs (#157/#169/#171/#173) were unresolvable. One PR per package; Renovate runs flutter pub upgrade per PR so an unresolvable set fails loudly. Add a pub groupName only after one grouped pub PR is proven to resolve.

webcrypto pinned in pubspec.yaml: >=0.6.1 native-assets hook needs CMake + MSVC C++ on the build PC; the asset ships nowhere (web=JS path, Android=NDK). Security advisories still surface via GitHub Dependabot alerts (kept on).

Encrypted content store: sqlite3 3.x removed package:sqlite3/open.dart which content_db.dart imports for the SQLCipher open override; drift/drift_dev move with it; sqlcipher_flutter_libs 0.7.0 is +eol. Taking these = rewriting the open override with an on-device integration run.

Pinned by the Flutter SDK, not by us: flutter_test pins clock 1.1.2; build_runner 2.16+ wants analyzer >=13.3 (SDK meta 1.18.0) and is capped by drift_dev's analyzer <11. Re-check after a Flutter SDK upgrade.
environment.sdk / environment.flutter are extracted as deps named dart / flutter (no depType). Pinned deliberately: CI parity via flutter-version-file (Batch 8.1); bumps are a one-line manual edit.
GitHub Actions: grouped monthly (was dependabot open-pull-requests-limit 2).
